**Daily Devotional**

**April 3**

*10 He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever. (1 Chronicles 22:10 KJV)*

The Lord was telling David that Solomon, David’s son, would be the one to build the Temple of God for the Lord. This promise to David that his throne would rule over the kingdom of Israel forever was certainly brought to fruit when Jesus was born and shall rule over His kingdom forever (Revelation 5:13). The name of Solomon was originally given by God to be Jedidiah, which means “beloved of the Lord”. The name Solomon means “peaceful”. Even though Solomon did fall away from God in his later years, God kept His promise to David by having Jesus born of his descendants. God always keeps His word – praise God!

This is another example to how faithful our God is, as when He makes promises and covenants in the Bible, He always keeps His word, as He can not lie (Titus 1:2). That makes us all the more sure that when His Word says we are saved, and heirs with Jesus of all God has, we can know that it will come to pass - as long as we don‘t blasphemy the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32), or fall away and become reprobate (Romans 1:28), or disobey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). Praise our Holy God for His wonderful Words, Blessings, Promises and His integrity.

Saol hurt, this pain in her chest. A pain so great it would claw up at her, threaten to overwhelm her. A well of darkness within her, a feeling so deep and filled with despair that it threatened to overwhelm her. This darkness, this sadness, it was all because of him. He had hurt her, he was all he she could think of. She could not create life, when she had no desire to live. All she wanted was for the darkness to take her, to drown in her own despair. "Let it end" she begged. How could she have been such a fool, to create such a thing, to be used in such a way.

She had believed in him, she had thought he cared! Why, why would he do this to her, subvert her like this? An anger arose within her, she was the child of War. It was a new sensation, like a righteous warmth, it rose up against this dark oppression. "I will teach you a lesson, you shall never harm another like you harmed me, like you hurt me!"

Saol gathered forth the darkness within in her, the sadness and the anger, and she poured it into a new type of life. ["Wraiths, I will name you"](http://i.imgur.com/JlyfZau.jpg) she said, "you shall hunt him endlessly, and when you find him, you shall tear him apart, like he did to me!"

She moulded the perfect hunters, relentless, they would always sense the direction of their prey. They never stopped moving, like the wind they would run, cursed to hunt, until the day they destroyed him. "Hunt the King" she said.
